# aayushict

> Know what's priced in. Trade what changes. Macro events (NFP, CPI, the Fed) linked to real Nasdaq futures trades, written by Aayush Namdev, who trades NQ and MNQ on funded accounts from India. Not a signal service. Not advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aayushict.space/): who I am, how I trade, and the gap this site fills.
- [Start here](https://aayushict.space/start-here/): one real NFP night on 7 August 2026 with the numbers and screenshots, why it was rare, and how to trade US futures from India through prop firms.
- [About](https://aayushict.space/about/): who Aayush Namdev is, how he trades (macro for direction, a 1 minute scalping model in the New York morning session), and his payouts so far with certificates.
- [Disclosure](https://aayushict.space/disclosure/): how the site earns, which links are affiliate links, and which are not.
- [Disclaimer](https://aayushict.space/disclaimer/): not advice, not a signal service, trading is risky.
- [Privacy](https://aayushict.space/privacy/): no cookies, cookieless visit counts through Vercel Analytics, email stored at Buttondown.
